dataset: CloudTCM bilingual disease and symptom source entries
medical_claim_policy: Source taxonomy labels only; a tag is not evidence of efficacy, diagnosis, or treatment equivalence.
identity_policy: One stable source-page ID per record. Repeated cards merge into category_ids; symptoms remain symptoms and are not promoted to diagnoses.
translation_policy: Display translations only. Labels do not convert symptoms into diagnoses or establish Western/TCM equivalence.
